price_field_note: MHP publishes a Suggested Retail Season Price List with two retail columns: MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) and MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price). There is no dealer/wholesale price column. MSRP values are recorded in the msrp field. The MAP value for each model is recorded in notes. Accessory items (covers, side shelf kits, rotisseries, grill accessories, grill maintenance, griddle) list only a single retail price; that single price is recorded in msrp. Items marked NLA (No Longer Available) have null prices and are listed in discontinued.
